nodes.description: Ownable.owner address; privileged owner of the contract.
BaseWallet._owner address; wallet owner stored in slot 0 of wallet data layout.
BaseWallet.modules mapping(address=>bool) of authorized modules.
BaseWallet.controller reference to the Controller contract that provides stores and factory address.
BaseWallet.methodToModule mapping(bytes4=>address) used by fallback dispatch.
Claimable.pendingOwner address awaiting claiming.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue lock slot (0 = unlocked).
GuardianStore.wallets mapping(address=>Wallet) holding guardians, inheritor, lastActive and lock state.
QuotaStore.quotas mapping(address=>Quota) holding rolling daily spending quota data.
HashStore.hashes mapping(address=>mapping(bytes32=>bool)) of consumed signed-request hashes.
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap mapping(wallet=>addr=>effectiveTime).
Ownable.transferOwnership / Claimable.transferOwnership; guarded by onlyOwner.
Ownable.renounceOwnership; sets owner to address(0), guarded by onlyOwner.
Claimable.claimOwnership; guarded by onlyPendingOwner.
BaseWallet.initOwner; guarded by onlyFromFactory, initializes _owner once.
BaseWallet.init; sets controller and adds initial modules.
BaseWallet.setOwner; guarded by onlyFromModule, changes wallet owner.
BaseWallet.setController; guarded by onlyFromModule.
BaseWallet.addModule; guarded by onlyFromFactoryOrModule.
BaseWallet.removeModule; guarded by onlyFromModule, calls module.deactivate via try/catch.
BaseWallet.bindMethod; guarded by onlyFromModule, binds a selector to a module.
BaseWallet.transact; guarded by onlyFromFactoryOrModule, performs arbitrary call/delegatecall/staticcall.
BaseWallet.fallback; dispatches msg.data to a module bound to msg.sig via low-level call.
BaseWallet.receive; accepts plain Ether transfers.
BaseWallet._addModule; validates module against registry and calls Module.activate().
BaseWallet._call; private dispatcher performing call/delegatecall/staticcall.
GuardianStore.addGuardian; guarded by onlyWalletModule, writes guardian array.
GuardianStore.removeGuardian; guarded by onlyWalletModule.
SecurityStore.setLock; guarded by onlyWalletModule, toggles wallet lock.
SecurityStore.touchLastActive; guarded by onlyWalletModule, stores block.timestamp.
SecurityStore.setInheritor; guarded by onlyWalletModule, sets inheritor and waiting period.
QuotaStore.checkAndAddToSpent; consults PriceOracle and consumes quota.
QuotaStore._addToSpent; adds amount to rolling spent quota using safe math.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate; consumes a hash, guarded by requireWalletModule.
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist; guarded by onlyWalletModule.
WhitelistStore.removeFromWhitelist; guarded by onlyWalletModule.
AddOfficialGuardianModule.activate; uses msg.sender as wallet, adds guardian and removes itself.
MathUint.mul; multiplication with overflow check.
MathUint.sub; subtraction with underflow check.
MathUint.add; addition with overflow check.
AddressUtil.sendETH; low-level call forwarding value with gas limit.
AddressUtil.fastCall; assembly-level call with value and return-data copy.
SignatureUtil.verifySignatures; loops over sorted signers verifying each signature.
SignatureUtil.verifySignature; dispatches EOA vs ERC1271 verification.
SignatureUtil.recoverECDSASigner; ECDSA recovery with s-range and v checks.
SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature; staticcall to signer isValidSignature.
BaseModule.reimburseGasFee; charges quota and transfers gas token to recipient.
msg.sender; used throughout for authorization checks.
block.timestamp; used for guardian validity, quota rolling window and whitelist timing.
target.call{value:value}(data) inside BaseWallet._call (mode 1).
target.delegatecall(data) inside BaseWallet._call (mode 2).
target.staticcall(data) inside BaseWallet._call (mode 3).
module.call{value:msg.value}(msg.data) inside BaseWallet.fallback.
recipient.call{value:amount,gas:gasLimit}("") inside AddressUtil.sendETH.
ecrecover(signHash,v,r,s) inside SignatureUtil.recoverECDSASigner.
Multiplication a*b that may overflow if unchecked.
Subtraction a-b that may underflow if unchecked.
Addition a+b that may overflow if unchecked.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
_initialOwner parameter of BaseWallet.initOwner.
_controller parameter of BaseWallet.init.
_modules array parameter of BaseWallet.init.
_module parameter of addModule/removeModule.
mode parameter of transact selecting call type.
to parameter of transact (destination address).
value parameter of transact (Ether amount).
data parameter of transact (calldata payload).
wallet parameter identifying the wallet in store functions.
addr parameter of addGuardian.
validSince parameter of addGuardian compared with block.timestamp.
returnData returned by _call in transact.
success flag returned by _call in transact.
g Data.Guardian memory copy in addGuardian.
pos guardian index in addGuardian.
available quota local in checkAndAddToSpent.
value computed from priceOracle.tokenValue in checkAndAddToSpent.
gasCost = gasAmount.mul(gasPrice) in reimburseGasFee.
a parameter of MathUint.mul.
b parameter of MathUint.mul.
c result of a*b in MathUint.mul.
recipient address payable in AddressUtil.sendETH.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership on msg.sender.
onlyPendingOwner compares msg.sender to pendingOwner.
onlyFromFactory requires msg.sender == controller.walletFactory().
onlyFromModule requires modules[msg.sender] for setOwner.
onlyFromModule gates setController on msg.sender.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule checks modules[msg.sender] or factory address.
onlyFromModule gates removeModule on msg.sender.
onlyFromModule gates bindMethod on msg.sender.
onlyFromFactoryOrModule gates transact on msg.sender.
fallback uses msg.sig (caller-controlled) to look up methodToModule then checks modules[module].
onlyWalletModule calls requireWalletModule(wallet) which checks Wallet(wallet).hasModule(msg.sender).
onlyWalletModule checks msg.sender as module of wallet.
onlyWalletModule gates setLock on msg.sender.
onlyWalletModule gates touchLastActive on msg.sender.
onlyWalletModule gates setInheritor on msg.sender.
AddOfficialGuardianModule.activate treats msg.sender as the calling wallet.
modules[msg.sender] authorization lookups in onlyFromModule/onlyFromFactoryOrModule.
addGuardian requires validSince >= block.timestamp and stores timestamp-based status.
removeGuardian requires validUntil >= block.timestamp.
touchLastActive writes uint64(block.timestamp) to wallets[wallet].lastActive.
setInheritor stores uint64(block.timestamp) as lastActive used for inheritance timing.
QuotaStore uses block.timestamp to compute the rolling spent-quota window.
addToWhitelist clamps effectiveTime to block.timestamp when it is in the past.
activate passes block.timestamp as the guardian validSince value.
transact delegates to _call which performs an external call before state can be considered final.
_call mode 1 invokes target.call{value:value}(data), enabling arbitrary external execution.
_call mode 2 invokes target.delegatecall(data), running external code in wallet storage context.
_call mode 3 invokes target.staticcall(data) for read-only external calls.
fallback forwards msg.value and msg.data to a module via low-level call.
sendETH forwards Ether to an arbitrary recipient via call with a custom gas limit.
fastCall performs an assembly call with value to an arbitrary address.
_addModule calls Module(_module).activate() re-entering the module contract.
removeModule calls Module(_module).deactivate() inside try/catch, re-entering the module.
recoverECDSASigner returns ecrecover(signHash, v, r, s) after s-range and v checks.
verifySignature dispatches contract signers to verifyERC1271Signature which staticcalls the signer.
verifySignature uses recoverECDSASigner for EOA signature recovery.
verifySignatures iterates over signers and calls verifySignature for each.
verifyERC1271Signature performs signer.staticcall(callData) on an untrusted signer contract.
mul computes c = a * b then verifies a == 0 || c / a == b to detect overflow.
sub requires b <= a before computing a - b to prevent underflow.
add computes c = a + b then requires c >= a to detect overflow.
_addToSpent adds the new amount to the freshly decayed spent quota using MathUint.add.
reimburseGasFee computes gasCost = gasAmount.mul(gasPrice) via MathUint.
checkAndAddToSpent calls _addToSpent after validating the available quota.
QuotaStore consults PriceOracle.tokenValue, an external contract call on untrusted token amounts.
transferOwnership/claimOwnership writes the new owner to the owner state variable.
renounceOwnership sets owner = address(0).
claimOwnership clears pendingOwner after transferring ownership.
initOwner assigns _owner = _initialOwner.
init assigns controller = _controller.
setOwner writes the new owner to _owner.
setController writes controller = newController.
addModule delegates to internal _addModule with the registry.
removeModule deletes modules[_module].
bindMethod writes methodToModule[_method] = _module.
_addModule sets modules[_module] = true after registry validation.
addGuardian mutates wallets[wallet].guardians and guardianIdx.
removeGuardian updates wallets[wallet] guardian status and timestamp.
setLock writes wallets[wallet].locked.
touchLastActive writes wallets[wallet].lastActive.
setInheritor writes inheritor, inheritWaitingPeriod and lastActive.
checkAndAddToSpent reads and updates quotas[wallet].
_addToSpent writes spentAmount and spentTimestamp into quotas[wallet].
verifyAndUpdate sets hashes[wallet][hash] = true after module authorization.
addToWhitelist writes effectiveTimeMap[wallet][addr].
removeFromWhitelist deletes effectiveTimeMap[wallet][addr].
reimburseGasFee performs a token transfer via transactTokenTransfer/_call chain.
fallback is reachable by any external caller and derives module from msg.sig.
activate triggers BaseWallet.removeModule(address(this)) on the re-entered wallet.
